reserved.27-32: Wired to the flash chip. Using them crashes the board.

avoid.0: Strapping pin. Held low at reset, the board starts in download mode.
avoid.3: Strapping pin. Selects the JTAG source at reset.
avoid.19-20: Native USB D- and D+. On boards that use native USB for serial, using them cuts the link to Thingstudio.
avoid.26: PSRAM chip select on chips and modules with PSRAM.
avoid.33-37: Used by octal flash or PSRAM on modules that have it (for example N8R8, N16R8).
avoid.43-44: UART0 TX and RX. On boards with a USB-serial chip, these carry the link to Thingstudio.
avoid.45: Strapping pin. Sets flash voltage at reset.
avoid.46: Strapping pin. Sets boot mode at reset.
